title: Melody Maker
description: A React app that generates MIDI files from live recordings
readme:
# Melody Maker

Melody Maker is a React-based application that captures live microphone recordings of singing or whistling, detects pitch in real-time using the Web Audio API, and generates standard MIDI files from the transcription.

## Core Features
* **Real-time Pitch Ingestion**: Reads audio stream from `getUserMedia` and runs autocorrelation calculations in a requestAnimationFrame loop.
* **Tone.js Synthesizer Playback**: Instantly plays back transcribed notes back to the user for immediate verification.
* **MIDI Exporter**: Uses a browser-compatible MIDI encoder to generate and download `.mid` files directly.
* **Visual Piano Roll**: Displays incoming notes in a dynamic grid layout.

## System Architecture
```mermaid
graph LR
    Mic[Microphone Input] --> AudioCtx[Web Audio API Context]
    AudioCtx --> PitchDet[Pitch Detection / Autocorrelation]
    PitchDet --> NotesTrans[Note Quantization]
    NotesTrans --> SynPlayback[Tone.js Playback]
    NotesTrans --> MIDIWriter[MIDI Writer exporter]
```
